clue.text: Rearranged pretty sash during the dance

indicators.note: rearranged tells us the letters of the next two words are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone reworks a pretty sash while a dance is going on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rearranged' shuffles PRETTY SASH into a Scottish dance name; 'during the' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: A strathspey is a slow Scottish country dance, akin to a reel.

clue.text: Subscription owing to master

parts.note: sub is the short form of subscription, as in a club sub
money owing is money due

explanation.surface: A subscription still owed to the head of a household or school.
explanation.definitionFit: To master an opponent is to overpower or conquer them.

clue.text: Give back profit

definitions.meaning: to hand something back to its owner
the yield or gain made on an investment

explanation.definitionFit: Returning is handing back; a return is also the gain earned on money invested.

clue.text: Is this what one is encouraged to do whilst on the psychiatrist's couch?

definitions.text: Is this what one is encouraged to do whilst on the psychiatrist's couch?

parts.words: Is this what one is encouraged to do whilst on the psychiatrist's couch?
parts.note: a patient in therapy is urged to speak freely and for a long time about themselves

explanation.surface: A question about what a patient should do during a session of analysis.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking at great length is the whole point of a talking cure.

clue.text: Make notes about char endlessly

indicators.note: endlessly means the final letter of the word for char is cut off

parts.note: to char something is to singe or scorch it

explanation.surface: Writing notes on the subject of charring or perhaps on a cleaning lady.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is a link here; 'endlessly' drops the last E of SINGE.
explanation.definitionFit: Singers produce musical notes with their voices.

clue.text: Flotilla that was remarkable, 150 realised

indicators.note: remarkable can be read as re-markable, able to be marked out again in a new order

parts.note: C is Roman 100 and L is Roman 50, together 150

explanation.surface: A tribute to a fleet whose remarkable feat realised 150 of something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'remarkable' signals an anagram of CL plus REALISED.
explanation.definitionFit: An escadrille is a small squadron, of ships or aircraft, hence a small fleet.

clue.text: Hawk coming from valley, ascending

indicators.note: coming from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A hawk rises up out of a valley.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ascending' looks like a reversal signal, but the hawk sits forwards inside vallEY AScending.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyas is a young hawk taken from the nest for falconry.

parts.note: the number is both a calendar date and the title of an Orwell novel, so a date that is also a volume

explanation.definitionFit: An annual volume is named for its year, and 1984 is both a year and a book.

clue.text: Cloth worker in one of the forces

parts.note: serge is a hard-wearing woollen cloth
a worker ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: A textile worker who serves in the armed forces.
explanation.definitionFit: A sergeant is a rank in the army or police, both called forces.

clue.text: Where traffic congestion occurs near Cork

definitions.meaning: a narrow point in a road where vehicles pile up
the narrow top part of a bottle, just below its stopper

explanation.definitionFit: A road narrowing causes jams, and the narrow top of a bottle sits just under its stopper.

clue.text: Loud music at amusement park

parts.note: f, forte, is the musical marking for loud
an air is a tune

explanation.surface: Loud music is playing at a funfair.
explanation.definitionFit: A funfair is a travelling show of rides and stalls, an amusement park.

clue.text: Trying more to revolutionise part of mathematics

indicators.note: to revolutionise something is to change it utterly, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Trying harder to transform a branch of mathematics.
explanation.definitionFit: Trigonometry is the branch of mathematics dealing with triangles and angles.

clue.text: Tumult for golfer in Middle Eastern country

indicators.note: in places the golfer inside the letters for the country

parts.note: UAR, the United Arab Republic, the former union of Egypt and Syria
a pro is a professional golfer

explanation.surface: A golfer abroad in the Middle East causes a commotion.
explanation.definitionFit: An uproar is a noisy disturbance, a commotion.

clue.text: A dung-beetle from Elba, very attractive!

parts.note: a dor is a kind of dung beetle

indicators.note: from here means the word Elba is rebuilt out of its own letters

explanation.surface: Admiring a dung beetle found on the island of Elba.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' signals an anagram of ELBA, making ABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Adorable means delightful or charming, deeply attractive.

clue.text: Prison meal served up cold

indicators.note: food served up is dished out in a new arrangement, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A prison meal is served up cold.
explanation.definitionFit: A cold, distant manner is detached and lacking warmth or personal feeling.

clue.text: Admitting the error coming from the mountain?

definitions.meaning: backing down and conceding one was wrong
descending from a peak, read literally

explanation.definitionFit: Backing down after an argument is phrased as descending, as a mountaineer does.

clue.text: Astronaut finds room for our species

parts.note: room means space, as in room to move
man means humankind, our species

explanation.surface: An astronaut finds space for the human race.
explanation.definitionFit: A space traveller is an astronaut.

clue.text: Tailless dog from former Yugoslav area

indicators.note: tailless means the last letter of the dog breed is cut off

parts.note: a Dalmatian is a spotted breed of dog

explanation.surface: A dog without a tail comes from a region of old Yugoslavia.
explanation.definitionFit: Dalmatia is the coastal region of Croatia, once part of Yugoslavia.

clue.text: Being candid and outspoken even before trading

indicators.note: before puts the word for even ahead of the word for trading

parts.note: plain can mean flat or level, so even
dealing means trading or doing business

explanation.surface: Honest frank speech even before any trading starts.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain-dealing is frank honesty and straightforwardness in conduct.

clue.text: Bird, duck in Loire swimming

indicators.note: in sets the duck inside the shuffled river name
swimming means the letters of the river name move around

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O

explanation.surface: A bird and a duck are swimming in the River Loire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swimming' rearranges LOIRE to ORILE, and 'in' puts O inside it after the I.
explanation.definitionFit: The oriole is a brightly coloured songbird.

clue.text: Alternatively Diana in south Dakota finds it dirty

indicators.note: in places the first two pieces inside the abbreviations that follow

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for Dakota
or introduces an alternative
Di is the short form of Diana

explanation.surface: Diana, or someone else, visits South Dakota and finds it seedy.
explanation.definitionFit: Sordid means squalid or filthy.

clue.text: Comes to, a change from an unconscious state

indicators.note: a change from means the letters of the preceding words are reworked

explanation.surface: Someone comes round after being knocked out.
explanation.definitionFit: Comatose means in a coma, deeply unconscious.

clue.text: Excited by more in the early stages of development

indicators.note: excited means stirred up, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Something stirred into action early in its growth.
explanation.definitionFit: Something still in its first unformed stage is described as an embryo.

clue.text: Go on, there is nothing above the curve

indicators.note: in a down entry above puts the first piece on top of the second

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing
gee, as in gee up, urges a horse to go on

explanation.surface: Encouragement to keep going, with nothing showing above the bend.
explanation.definitionFit: An ogee is an S-shaped double curve, as in a moulding or arch.

clue.text: Sheep can't get on, blockhead

indicators.note: can't get means the following word is left out of the word for sheep

parts.note: mutton is sheep meat
taken as written

explanation.surface: Sheep that cannot get along with an idiot.
explanation.definitionFit: A mutt is a slang term for a stupid person.

clue.text: A dubbing from the Queen

parts.note: being tapped on the shoulder with a sword by the monarch, an honour

explanation.definitionFit: The monarch confers a title of honour by tapping a sword on each shoulder.

clue.text: Old shipbuilder coming from Hanoi I left

indicators.note: coming from means the answer is made by rearranging letters taken out of the city name

explanation.surface: A veteran shipbuilder, from Hanoi, has departed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I left' removes I from HANOI, and the remaining HANO is shuffled.
explanation.definitionFit: Noah built the ark in Genesis, an ancient vessel-maker.

clue.text: Dull teacher, a lazy person!

parts.note: sleepy means dull and sluggish
a head is the head teacher of a school

explanation.surface: A tedious schoolmaster who is a lazybones.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleepyhead is someone drowsy or idle.
